scenarios.setup: Two workbench replicas share one Restate authority and one PostgreSQL store; B registers last, so the turn A accepts executes on B. Observers follow the session feed on A (before and mid-turn) and on B.
scenarios.fault: Hold the provider stream mid-turn, SIGKILL B under it, restart B in place.
scenarios.observable: The Run is pinned to B's deployment; both replicas' snapshots are one durable head; every A feed converges on the durable rows once and in order. With the process-local memory live replay store, B's live activity reaches B's feed and never A's, and A converges through the durable head (replay gap and snapshot). With the shared PostgreSQL live replay store (FIG-5101), A's feeds carry B's live activity before commit and converge without a gap.
